answer: Each agent identity is registered in the quartz state tree only after a zero-knowledge attestation verifies an SGX quote proving enclave-held key continuity; a VDF binds its nonce to the lagoon consensus contract. The garden registry charges a quadratic bonding curve, O(N^2), and irreversibly slashes collateral on duplicate proofs; forging N identities therefore requires continuously provisioning distinct physical silicon and producing valid attestations, making Sybil cost superlinear.
